findings.reason: Supports sign-in log retention. Migration 057 identifies this path for its age-bound delete.

findings.reason: Supports limiting cancellation requests by normalized email and request time in create_billing_cancel_request.

findings.name: unused_index

findings.name: unused_index
findings.detail: Index \`matches_subject_code_idx\` on table \`public.matches\` has not been used
findings.reason: Matches subject-scoped Play lookups. The unique code index is another access path; this finding alone does not demonstrate a safe drop.

findings.name: unused_index
findings.detail: Index \`idx_question_reports_created_at\` on table \`public.question_reports\` has not been used
findings.reason: Orders reports by creation time. The fixture does not represent operator report-list volume.

findings.name: unused_index

findings.reason: Preserved composite report/version lookup. Migration 081 deliberately retained it when retiring the old single-column index.

findings.name: unused_index

findings.reason: Supports removing expired submission receipts by creation time in the daily retention routine.

productionUnusedIndexesRetained.coding_collection_items_order_idx: Ordered collection item reads in lib/coding/practice-handlers.ts.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.billing_checkout_consents_user_idx: Account erasure filters checkout consent by user_id.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.billing_cancel_requests_email_idx: Cancellation-request rate control by normalized email and requested_at in 039.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.match_participants_user_idx: Account erasure across matches by user_id.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.flashcards_user_subject_created_idx: Covers subject-scoped card list and creation order. On this seed the planner used flashcards_pkey after 085.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.quiz_submissions_challenge_strikes_idx: Migration 069 counts previous strikes on a Challenge.
productionUnusedIndexesRetained.question_reports_item_version_idx: Used for item/version lookups; retained as the replacement in 081.

limits: Each fixture database has its own short-lived index statistics. Unused notices here do not measure production traffic. Hosted SQL tests exercise provider-shaped Realtime policy objects. Separate staging clients are needed to verify actual socket delivery.
